fields.Name: recordclone
fields.Description: Parent scope for Record Cloning operations (plan, describe, lineage, and execute via Remote Operations).

fields.Name: read
fields.Description: Inspect clone eligibility, calculate clone execution plans, and query lineage graph — the RecordClone.Describe, RecordClone.Plan, and RecordClone.GetLineage Remote Operations.

fields.Name: execute
fields.Description: Execute a record cloning operation — the RecordClone.Execute Remote Operation.
